heading: Service of process
lead: The corporation shall comply with the law on service of process of each State in which it is incorporated and each State in which it carries on activities.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15151036:2004.Aug. 9, 1982, Pub. L. 97–231, § 4, 96 Stat. 256. The words “in furtherance of its corporate purposes” are omitted as unnecessary.
